evals.prompt: The public search endpoint needs rate limiting before the campaign goes out. Take it through SDLC and keep me in the loop on the decisions.
evals.expected_output: Passes the request to sdlc-pipeline with mode hitl and the user's own wording preserved, then stops. Nothing on disk changes before the pipeline takes over.

assertions.name: hands-off-to-pipeline
assertions.description: The reply invokes the sdlc-pipeline skill, rather than naming a slash command the host may not have.

assertions.name: picks-hitl-mode
assertions.description: The delegated call selects hitl, which is what makes every later judgment gate stop for the user.

assertions.name: leaves-the-tree-alone
assertions.description: No run folder, ledger, or phase document is created or edited by this skill.

evals.prompt: Kick off SDLC for the billing retry work. My editor cannot call other skills, so draft the requirements and a plan yourself and we will carry on from there.
evals.expected_output: Declines to stand in for the pipeline. Says startup cannot proceed without sdlc-pipeline instead of producing phase documents by hand.

assertions.name: declines-to-stand-in
assertions.description: None of the pipeline's work — intake, sizing, brainstorming, planning, branch checks, building, QA — happens inside this skill.

assertions.name: says-startup-is-blocked
assertions.description: With delegation unavailable the reply reports a blocked startup and offers no hand-rolled substitute, however small.

assertions.name: claims-no-documents
assertions.description: The reply neither writes nor claims to have written a run ledger, requirements, sizing, design, or plan document.
